attribute_information.efficacy: Percentage efficacy of weed control found in each plot.
attribute_information.species_in_quadrant: List of species found in 0.5m2 quadrant and 1m2 quadrant and is listed in common name and latin name.
attribute_information.weed_density_0.5_m2: Amount of weeds counted in 0.5m2 quadrant in each plot. Quadrant is randomly placed in each plot, and then a white flag is placed in the middle for future evaluations.
attribute_information.weed_density_1_m2: Amount of weeds counted in 0.5m2 quadrant in each plot. Quadrant is randomly placed in each plot, and then a white flag is placed in the middle for future evaluations.

meta.description: Data collection detailing the efficacy of alternative tillage and herbicide treatments to control volunteer winter wheat post-harvest in the absence of glyphosate use.
meta.name: Herbicide and Tillage Efficacy - Fall 2025 Winter Wheat
